decisions.reason: As a newly launched line that builds directly on the firm's established marking systems and service capabilities, its uncertainty is still worth carrying and the cost of keeping it appears low relative to its strategic fit.
This thermal inkjet printer is close to the core offer in a growing, innovation-active firm and industry, so management would likely preserve the option while market learning and adoption continue.

Although somewhat more exposed to portfolio overlap and resource comparison with other printer technologies, this piezo inkjet product is still a recent, adjacent innovation whose upside likely outweighs near-term carrying costs.
